title: Microphone is off
note: A calm card, not an error: it offers to type the letter instead (first), open iOS Settings, or close. The browser denial is simulated by refusing getUserMedia; on a phone it is iOS's permission state, and "Open Settings" is native and does nothing on web.
text: Close We can't hear you yet Allow the microphone in Settings to speak your letters. Or type instead. Type instead Open Settings
lines: Allow the microphone in Settings to speak your letters. Or type instead.
